note: Which art folder each problem type 0-33 draws from: a number below 900 is the folder assets/problem_art/bNNN (the pictures in id order, the first is the panel), a number of 1000 and up is the loose picture assets/problem_art/single/pa_<number>.png. This is the layout of the pack's files (folder and file names, as the dev pack's inventory has them), committed so that the dev generator needs no importer output (extracted/ is not committed). Two types may share a folder.
